ingredients: 1 ½ cups liquid (water, milk, or juice)
1 ½ to 2 cups fruits, fresh or frozen
Optional add-ins: leafy greens, chia seeds, flax seeds, sweetener, protein powder, nut butter
directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth.

ingredients: 1 serving chocolate milk powder or protein powder
Small handful of nuts (walnuts, almonds, or pecans)
directions: Put all ingredients in blender. Blend until smooth. Mixture may remain slightly lumpy.

ingredients: 2 cups unsweetened frozen sliced or chopped peaches
directions: Put yogurt, juice, vanilla, and banana in blender first. Add peaches. Pulse, then blend on high. Add more liquid if stiff. Serve immediately.
Combine all ingredients in blender. Blend until smooth.
Blend all ingredients until smooth.

ingredients: 1 tbsp chia seeds or ground flax seeds
Up to 2 tbsp honey or maple syrup
Optional mix-ins: fruit, nut butter, cocoa powder, coconut, nuts
directions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl or storage jar. Refrigerate 4–8 hours. Eat cold or microwave before eating.

ingredients: ½ cup unsweetened plain almond milk
2 tbsp natural peanut butter or almond butter
Optional toppings: bananas, strawberries, other fruit, granola, ground flax or chia seeds
directions: Mix ingredients together. Store in fridge overnight. Add extra toppings before eating. Can be eaten cold or warmed.

ingredients: Optional toppings: dried fruit, fresh fruit, nuts, seeds, mini chocolate chips, peanut butter, jam
directions: Blend rolled oats until powdery. Mix with remaining ingredients. For use, combine ½ cup mix with 2/3 cup water, microwave 2 min, add toppings.

ingredients: Nut butter, bananas, honey, avocado, eggs, hummus, veggies, Nutella, low-fat cheese, cucumbers, jam (depending on topping combination)
directions: Spread desired toppings on toast. Get creative with combinations. Serve immediately.

ingredients: Cooked and diced bacon or sausage
directions: Scramble eggs. Sauté potatoes and peppers. Cook bacon/sausage. Fill tortillas with ingredients, roll up, wrap in plastic, store in freezer. Microwave 3–5 min to reheat.
Cover eggs in boiling water. Boil 6–7 min for soft, 8–9 min for medium, 10 min for hard yolk. Remove carefully.
Mix dry ingredients. Combine wet ingredients. Stir together until slightly lumpy. Cook on greased skillet until golden.

ingredients: ¼ cup sugar or mashed bananas
Optional: blueberries, cranberries, pumpkin, spices depending on variation
directions: Preheat oven 400°F. Mix dry and wet ingredients separately, then combine. Fill muffin pans 2/3 full. Bake 20–25 min.

ingredients: ½ cup cooking oil or yogurt
directions: Mix dry ingredients. Beat egg yolks with milk and oil, then combine. Beat egg whites to stiff peaks and fold in. Pour onto waffle iron and cook until done.

Heat skillet over medium-high heat. Place tortilla in pan, layer tomato, mozzarella, and basil on half of tortilla. Cook 1 min, fold tortilla, cook 2 more minutes until cheese melts and tortilla is brown on both sides. Slice and serve.

ingredients: Optional toppings: salsa, guacamole, cilantro, lime
directions: Heat oil, sauté onions and peppers 4 min until tender-crisp. Remove veggies. Coat tortilla with cooking spray, add ¼ cheese, top with second tortilla. Cook 2 min per side until cheese melts. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Serve with toppings.

ingredients: Small tostada shells or tortilla chips
Optional: taco sauce, jalapenos, peppers, beans, olives, tomatoes
directions: Warm tortilla. Place dollop of queso in center. Add taco meat and tostada shell. Top with sour cream, lettuce, cheese, and optional ingredients. Fold edges toward center. Flip into hot pan fold-side down, press, cook 2-3 min per side until browned.
Brown ground beef in non-stick skillet. Drain fat. Add taco seasoning and water, cook until water evaporates and meat is coated.

recipe_name: Nut Butter and Banana Open Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tbsp almond butter or peanut butter
Optional toppings: walnuts, raisins, almond flakes, sesame seeds, chia seeds
directions: Slice banana lengthwise. Mix nut butter with tahini and sweetener. Layer on banana slices. Add toppings if desired and enjoy.
Boil eggs 12 min. Peel and mash. Mix with mayonnaise, mustard, celery, salt, pepper. Spread on bread, add lettuce.

ingredients: ¼ cup mayo or Miracle Whip
2 leaves iceberg lettuce or baby spinach
directions: Mix drained tuna with mayo. Spread on bread, add pickles and lettuce/spinach.
Preheat oven 350°F. Mix tuna, mayo, dill, cayenne, salt, pepper. Spread on bread, top with cheese. Bake 5–10 min.

recipe_name: Quick Ramen with Protein and Veggies
ingredients: Protein options: boiled egg, beef, chicken, pork, tofu
Vegetables: frozen Asian veggies, carrots, zucchini, broccoli, corn, peas, onions
directions: Boil noodles 5 min in 2 cups water with half seasoning packet. Stir-fry protein and vegetables separately until cooked. Add protein and veggies to ramen. Serve.
Boil noodles 5 min in 2 cups water. Add seasoning. Add fresh veggies, cook 1–2 min. Optional: make well, add egg, poach or stir to create egg ribbons.

ingredients: Dressing: ½ cup white vinegar, ½ tsp sesame oil, ¼ cup olive oil, 2 tbsp sugar, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp pepper, 1 ramen seasoning packet
Salad: 1 head cabbage, sliced thin, 1 can drained chicken or 2 cups cooked chicken, 1 package dry crumbled ramen noodles
Optional: mandarin oranges, sliced almonds, sliced green onions
directions: Whisk dressing ingredients. Mix cabbage, chicken, crumbled noodles. Pour dressing over salad. Add optional ingredients. Refrigerate 30 min. Serve cold.

ingredients: 1 cup sliced pepperoncini or banana peppers
directions: Spread cream cheese on 4 slices. Layer cucumbers, sprouts, drizzle oil and vinegar. Add tomatoes, lettuce, pepperoncini. Spread avocado on remaining 4 slices, place on top and serve.

ingredients: ¾ cup fresh mozzarella, cut into pieces
directions: Whisk oil, vinegar, salt, pepper. Add lettuce, chicken, mozzarella, basil, tomatoes. Heat flatbreads in skillet, rub with garlic, fill with mixture, roll up, serve.

recipe_name: Garlic Parmesan Kale Pasta Meal Prep
ingredients: For the chicken: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts or 4–6 thighs, 1/4 cup olive oil, 1/4 cup lemon juice, 3 cloves garlic minced, 1/2 Tbsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp salt, freshly cracked pepper

For the kale pasta: 1 bunch kale, 1/2 lb angel hair pasta, 2 Tbsp olive oil, 2 Tbsp butter, 2 cloves garlic minced, 1/4 cup grated Parmesan, pinch salt, pinch pepper, pinch red pepper flakes (optional)
For the tomatoes: 1 pint cherry tomatoes, 1–2 Tbsp olive oil
directions: Marinate chicken with oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, pepper 30 min to 8 hours. Cook chicken in skillet 5–7 min per side. Prepare pasta: sauté garlic in olive oil and butter, add kale until wilted, toss with drained pasta, season, add Parmesan and optional red pepper. Cook tomatoes in olive oil until blistered. Portion chicken, pasta, and tomatoes into containers.

ingredients: Spaghetti: 12 oz spaghetti, 1 Tbsp olive oil, 1/2 lb lean ground beef (optional), 1 yellow onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1 zucchini, 2 carrots, 1/2 tsp basil, 1/2 tsp oregano, 1/4 tsp salt, freshly cracked pepper, pinch red pepper flakes, 24 oz pasta sauce
Broccoli: 1 lb frozen broccoli or fresh, 2 Tbsp olive oil, 1 Tbsp Montreal steak seasoning
directions: Brown ground beef in olive oil. Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Shred zucchini and carrots, add with herbs, seasoning, and sauté until tender. Add pasta sauce and heat. Cook spaghetti, drain, toss with 1 cup sauce, divide into containers, top with remaining sauce. Roast broccoli with olive oil and seasoning at 400°F: 20 min, stir, roast 10 more min. Portion with spaghetti.

ingredients: Dressing: 1/4 cup mayonnaise or plain yogurt, 1/4 cup plain yogurt, 1 tsp lemon juice, 1/2 tsp honey, 1 tsp curry powder, 1/4 tsp salt, ground pepper to taste

Salad: 2.5 cups chopped cooked chicken (or rotisserie), pinch salt & pepper, 2 stalks celery, 3 green onions, 1/2 cup sliced almonds, 1/2 cup raisins or craisins, 1 15 oz can cannellini beans drained and rinsed (optional)
directions: Whisk dressing ingredients. Season chicken with salt and pepper, cook on skillet or grill until done, cool. Dice celery, slice green onions, combine in large bowl with almonds, raisins, beans if using. Chop chicken, add to bowl. Pour dressing over salad, stir to coat. Portion into containers with optional apples, crackers, cheese.

attributes: vegetarian, vegan, protein-rich, dip or spread
ingredients: 2 16-oz cans garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed
3–4 green onions, cut into 1 inch pieces
directions: Place all ingredients in food processor or blender. Add water as needed to form smooth paste. Adjust seasonings to taste. Garnish with parsley if desired. Serve as dip for pita or veggies, or spread on toast or sandwiches.

ingredients: 1/2 cup crunchy or creamy nut butter
Optional add-ins: dried fruits, chopped nuts, cinnamon, dark chocolate chips, coconut flakes
directions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl. Form into 1-inch balls. Arrange on baking sheet or container, freeze 1 hour until set. Store in airtight container.

Preheat oven 350°F. Combine all ingredients except banana chips, spread on baking sheet, drizzle honey if desired, bake 10–15 minutes. Cool, add banana chips, stir, store in airtight container up to 5 days.
Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Spread nuts evenly on parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes, cool, store in jar or container for several weeks.

Mix ingredients in a bowl. Spread seeds on parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake at 350°F for 7–8 minutes until spices are fragrant and seeds begin to pop. Cool, store in jar or container for several weeks.

ingredients: 2/3 cup peanut butter (or other creamy nut butter)
directions: Pop popcorn. Melt honey and peanut butter together, mix in vanilla. Pour mixture over popcorn, stir to coat completely.

ingredients: 1–2 tbsp oil (olive, canola, coconut, or choice)
directions: Pop popcorn (air popper or stovetop). Mix spices and parmesan, sprinkle over popcorn, stir to coat. Let stand 10 minutes for cheese to melt.

ingredients: 1/2 cup sunflower seeds (or flax, chia, or mix)
directions: Microwave sugar and water 2 minutes, stir in vanilla and salt. Mix dry ingredients in large bowl, add sugar mixture. Bake on 2 cookie sheets at 275°F for 45 minutes, stirring and rotating sheets every 15 minutes. Cool completely before storing.

ingredients: 4 cups Rice Krispies or puffed rice
3 1/2–4 cups chopped nuts and/or dried fruit
directions: Mix oatmeal, cereal, nuts, fruit in large bowl. Heat peanut butter, honey, sugar, vanilla until combined. Stir into dry mix, press onto cookie sheet. Refrigerate or freeze until firm. Cut into bars, store in snack-size baggies in fridge or freezer.

ingredients: Cheese stick and fruit or veggies
Nuts and dried or fresh fruit
Toast with protein spread and vegetable or fruit
directions: Combine protein and produce component for a quick snack. No cooking required.

ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can black beans, drained and rinsed
Optional: 1 avocado, juice of 1 lime, 2 TB chopped fresh cilantro
directions: Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and jalapeño; cook 1 minute. Stir in quinoa, broth, beans, tomatoes, corn, chili powder, and cumin. Season with salt and pepper. Bring to boil, cover, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes until quinoa is cooked. Optional: stir in avocado, lime juice, and cilantro.

ingredients: 1–2 chicken breasts, cut into 2-inch strips (or beef)
1/4 C + 2 TB Mr. Yoshida’s Marinade and Cooking Sauce
directions: Marinate meat in 2 TB sauce. Cook vegetables in pan with cooking spray 3–4 minutes; remove. Sauté chicken until juices run clear, about 5 minutes. Whisk 1/4 cup sauce, water, and cornstarch; add to chicken over medium heat until thickened. Stir in cashews and vegetables. Serve over rice.

ingredients: 1 (10.5 oz.) can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1/3 C parmesan cheese, grated or shaved
directions: Heat olive oil in skillet over medium. Add onion, garlic, and salt; sauté 4–5 minutes. Add broccoli; sauté 3 minutes. Add chickpeas, broth, red pepper; cover and cook 3–9 minutes until broccoli softens. Uncover, season, sprinkle with parmesan, and serve.

ingredients: Toppings: cheese, broccoli, veggies, chili, butter, sour cream, salt, pepper
directions: Scrub and poke potatoes. Microwave in dish with lid or wrap in foil and bake at 400°F for 1 hour. Prepare toppings. Let potatoes cool 5 minutes before adding toppings.

ingredients: 1 Rhodes “Bake n Serve” loaf of bread
directions: Let dough rise all day. Roll out dough, layer ham and cheese. Bake at 350°F for 20–25 minutes.

ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken or mushroom
directions: Cook noodles; return to pot. Stir in soup, tuna, and milk. Adjust milk for consistency. Add salt, pepper, optional vegetables or seasonings. Heat through and serve.

ingredients: 12 oz fettuccine or pasta of choice
directions: Cook pasta al dente. Heat oil or butter in pan, sauté garlic 1 minute. Stir in flour 1 minute. Gradually whisk in stock and milk; simmer until thickened. Stir in Parmesan, salt, pepper. Toss pasta in sauce, top with parsley and extra Parmesan.

ingredients: 6–20 oz cheese or spinach & cheese tortellini
Optional: 1–1.5 grilled or baked chicken breast
directions: Cook tortellini, drain, return to pot. Add chicken if desired. Mix in pesto to coat, heat through, serve immediately.

ingredients: Fish filets (salmon, tilapia, mahi mahi, cod, halibut)
Seasonings: lemon pepper, Cajun, garlic, onion, butter, etc.
directions: Bake: Preheat oven 350°F (thawed) or 400°F (frozen). Season fish, bake 15–20 minutes until flaky. Pan-fry: Heat oil, season fish, cook 5–7 minutes per side until flaky.

ingredients: Meat: chicken, beef, pork, shrimp or vegetarian: rice, beans, veggies
Toppings: lettuce, tomato, avocado/guacamole, salsa, cilantro, sour cream/yogurt, hot sauce
directions: Cook meat (oven or stove) until done; season with taco seasoning. Assemble tacos or burritos with preferred toppings. Optional: use lettuce instead of tortilla for taco salad.

Heat oil in pan, cook onion and garlic until softened. Add lentils and seasoning; cook 1 minute. Add water, bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, simmer 25–30 minutes until lentils are tender. Uncover, cook 3–5 minutes to thicken. Assemble tacos with toppings.

ingredients: 1 14 1/2 oz can reduced sodium chicken broth
Optional toppings: cheese, cilantro, crushed tortilla chips, rice
directions: Cut chicken into cubes and brown, or cook directly in crockpot. Drain and rinse beans; add all ingredients to crockpot. Cover and cook on low 10–12 hours or high 5–6 hours. Serve with toppings.

ingredients: 1–2 tsp chipotle chili in adobo or chili sauce
Optional: cheese, sour cream, avocado, tortilla strips, oyster crackers
directions: Heat oil in saucepan, sauté onion and garlic 3–4 minutes. Add chicken broth, tomato sauce, and chipotle; bring to boil. Stir in cilantro and pour into crockpot. Add beans, tomatoes, corn, cumin, oregano, and chicken; cover and cook on low 4–6 hours. Shred chicken, return to soup, adjust seasoning, and serve with toppings.

Place chicken in crockpot. Combine lime juice and chili powder; pour over chicken. Cook low 5–6 hours until tender. Shred chicken, return to crockpot with corn and salsa; cook 30 minutes. Serve on tortillas with toppings.

ingredients: 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper or red pepper flakes
directions: Rub pork with spices. Place in crockpot with water. Cover and cook low 6–8 hours or high 4–5 hours until very tender. Shred and serve with sides or sauce.

ingredients: 1 C heavy cream or coconut milk
directions: Grease crockpot. Mix all ingredients except bay leaves, cream, cornstarch, and lemon in bowl. Transfer to crockpot, add bay leaves, cook low 8 hours (or high 4 hours). Mix cream with cornstarch, stir in, cook 20 min to thicken. Add lemon juice before serving. Optional: swap chicken for chickpeas.

ingredients: Optional: lettuce, corn, diced tomatoes, cheese, avocados, tortillas
directions: Mix sugar, salsa, cola. Place pork in crockpot, pour sauce over. Cook low 8 hours. Remove pork, shred, skim fat, return to crockpot to absorb juices. Serve in salad or tacos.

ingredients: 1/2 large yellow or white onion, chopped
2 15-oz cans low sodium cream of chicken soup
1 can instant or regular rice (white or brown)
directions: Brown chicken. Sauté celery and onions in olive oil. Add all ingredients to crockpot, stir. Cook low 6 hours or high 4 hours. Shred chicken gently, mix with thyme before serving.

ingredients: Kale, washed and separated from woody stalk
Citrus vinaigrette (or homemade with lemon vinaigrette + orange juice)
directions: Tear kale into bite-sized pieces. Cook quinoa per package directions. Mix all ingredients together. Adjust toppings to taste. Add dressing to bowl or individual servings.

ingredients: 2 bunches kale, mustard greens, or broccoli rabe
1 anchovy, chopped or 1 tsp anchovy paste (optional)
directions: Strip greens from stems, wash, dry, and cut into ribbons. Add remaining ingredients. Massage with hands until volume reduces by half and leaves become soft and shiny.

ingredients: 2 15-oz cans black beans, drained and rinsed
directions: Combine first set of ingredients in a large bowl. Whisk second set and pour over beans; stir. Add chilled rice and mix well. Serve cold.

recipe_name: Strawberry Spinach Salad with Lemon Poppy Seed Vinaigrette
total_time: 15 minutes (plus 1 hour for dressing if possible)
ingredients: Dressing: 1/3 cup lemon juice, 1 tsp lemon zest, 1 tsp grated onion, 1/4 cup rice wine vinegar, 1/4 cup canola oil, 3/4 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/4 cup sugar or honey, 2 tsp poppy seeds, 1 clove garlic
directions: Toss salad ingredients and serve. For dressing, combine ingredients, shake vigorously, refrigerate 1 hour if possible, then serve.

recipe_name: Pear Pomegranate Salad with Sweet Red Wine Vinaigrette
ingredients: Dressing: 1/2 cup red wine vinegar, 1/2 cup sugar, 1–2 cloves garlic, 1 tsp kosher salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1/2 cup canola or olive oil
directions: Cook pecans with sugar until coated; set aside. Combine remaining salad ingredients, top with candied pecans. Toss with vinaigrette before serving; add dressing to plated salads only to avoid sogginess.
Mix all ingredients, adding pineapple juice if too thick. Chill before serving.

recipe_name: Tuna and White Bean Waldorf Salad
ingredients: 2 15 1/2-oz cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
1/2 cup light mayonnaise or plain Greek yogurt
directions: Toss tuna, beans, celery, apple, onion, and cilantro. Puree remaining ingredients or mash with fork. Mix dressing with salad, season to taste. Serve over greens, in pita, tortilla, or lettuce wrap.

recipe_name: Couscous Salad with Chicken and Chopped Vegetables
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cooked boneless skinless chicken, chopped
Dressing: 1 cup plain low-fat yogurt, 3 tbsp fresh lemon juice, 1 tbsp honey
directions: Cook couscous with water, olive oil, and salt; fluff and cool. Sauté bell pepper, zucchini, and mushrooms; add to couscous. Add remaining salad ingredients. Whisk dressing ingredients and toss with salad before serving.

attributes: gluten-free option if using corn tortillas
ingredients: 1/2 packet taco seasoning or 1 1/2 tbsp homemade
5 corn tortillas, broken into small pieces
directions: Poach or grill chicken and dice into cubes. Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté carrots, celery, and onions with garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Add broth, tomatoes, Rotel, beans, taco seasoning, and chicken. Stir in tortillas and boil for 20 minutes. Reduce heat, add 4 oz cheese and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in milk and simmer another 10 minutes. Garnish with remaining cheese, tortilla chips, and cilantro if desired.

attributes: gluten-free option if using gluten-free stock
ingredients: 2 Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cubed
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in oil/butter until translucent. Add broccoli, potatoes, and chard and cook until bright green. Add stock and bring to boil, then simmer until potatoes are tender. Remove from heat, add cream, and puree until smooth. Stir in cheese until melted. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with optional garnishes.

recipe_name: Creamy Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
ingredients: 1 cup half-and-half, evaporated milk, or milk
directions: Melt butter or heat oil in a pot. Cook onion, carrots, and celery 5–7 minutes until tender. Stir in flour and cook 30 seconds. Gradually add broth while stirring. Add salt, pepper, and cooked rice. Bring to boil then simmer 2–3 minutes. Add chicken and milk/half-and-half, simmer 3–4 minutes more. Garnish with chives.

recipe_name: Curried Red Lentil and Quinoa Soup
ingredients: 1 (15 oz.) can garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed
directions: Rinse quinoa and cook per package directions. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté onion, carrots, and celery 10–15 minutes. Add garlic, ginger, curry powder and sauté 1 minute. Add lentils, broth, water, tomatoes, and chili sauce, bring to boil then simmer 10–15 minutes. Stir in garbanzo beans and cooked quinoa, cook 5 more minutes.

ingredients: 1 (14.5 oz.) can diced tomatoes with juice
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large pot. Bring to boil, cover, and simmer on medium-low heat 90 minutes. Adjust broth or barley for thickness. Remove bay leaves before serving.

ingredients: 2 (14 oz.) cans petite diced tomatoes, undrained
directions: Combine tomatoes, celery, carrots, onions, oregano, basil, broth, and bay leaf in slow cooker. Cook low 5–7 hours. Melt butter and cook with flour until golden. Gradually whisk in soup from slow cooker until smooth. Combine with remaining soup, add cheese and half-and-half, cook 30 more minutes. Serve with croutons.

Heat oil and sauté onions 5–10 minutes. Add garlic and curry powder, sauté 5 more minutes. Add tomatoes, broth, cinnamon, and salt; simmer 25 minutes. Cook pasta per package instructions and stir into soup. Optional: puree before serving.

ingredients: 1 tbsp dry onion or fresh chopped onion
2 cups water (more if using brown rice)
directions: Heat oil in a pan and brown the rice. Add tomato sauce with onion, garlic, and salt. Stir in water and vegetables. Cover and simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Optionally, cook in a rice cooker by adding all ingredients at once and fluffing with a fork when done.

ingredients: 2 tbsp minced cilantro (optional, added after cooking)
directions: Combine all ingredients except cilantro in a rice cooker and cook according to rice cooker instructions. Stir in cilantro after cooking if desired.

Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high, season with salt, pepper, rosemary, and red pepper for 30 seconds. Add onion and garlic and sauté until translucent. Add crushed tomatoes and basil, simmer 3 minutes. Pour in coconut milk, stir and simmer 3 minutes. Add broth and quinoa, bring to rapid boil, then cover and simmer 15 minutes on medium-low. Let sit 10 minutes before serving. Garnish with mozzarella and fresh basil if desired.
Scrub and cut potatoes into fourths. Add to a pan with cold water, bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes until tender. Drain, add butter, and sprinkle parsley on top before serving.

ingredients: Vegetables of choice: parsnips, carrots, potatoes, onions, green beans, turnips, rutabagas, winter squash, bell peppers, whole garlic cloves, eggplant, asparagus, beets, sweet potatoes, broccoli, cauliflower
Optional herbs/spices: thyme, rosemary, sage, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cut vegetables into 1" x 2" chunks. Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, and herbs/spices. Spread on a baking sheet and roast 30–50 minutes, turning every 10–15 minutes, until tender and golden. Serve immediately.

ingredients: Optional: freshly grated parmesan cheese and parsley
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cut sweet potatoes into 1/4–1/2 inch sticks, 3 inches long. Toss with olive oil and spices. Spread on 2 baking sheets without overlapping. Bake 15 minutes, flip, bake another 10 minutes until crisp. Optional: garnish with parmesan and parsley.

ingredients: 3 medium cucumbers, peeled and thinly sliced
1/3 cup fresh dill, chopped (or 1–2 tbsp dried)
directions: Place cucumbers in a bowl. Whisk together remaining ingredients. Pour over cucumbers and stir to combine. Cover and chill at least 2 hours, stirring occasionally. Adjust salt and dill to taste before serving.

ingredients: Garlic powder, Parmesan cheese, parsley or other seasonings
directions: Stir yeast, water, sugar, let sit 5 minutes. Mix in flour and salt, knead 3 minutes. Roll dough on greased cookie sheet, brush with butter, sprinkle with seasonings. Slice into breadsticks using a pizza cutter. Let rise 20 minutes. Bake 10–12 minutes at 400°F until golden brown.

Combine yeast and water, let stand 5 minutes. Add sugar, butter, salt, dry milk, 2 cups flour, and egg, beat until smooth. Add 2 more cups flour, then final cup flour 1/2 cup at a time. Knead until smooth. Let dough rise until tripled (~1 1/2 hours). Shape rolls, place on greased baking sheets, brush with butter, and bake 15–20 minutes at 400°F until golden.

ingredients: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch strips
directions: Combine orange juice, soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, and seasonings; set aside. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a large skillet until smoking. Stir-fry vegetables until crisp-tender (about 2 minutes), remove and set aside. Heat remaining oil, stir-fry chicken until browned and cooked through. Return vegetables to skillet, add cashews and sauce, cook until bubbly and thickened. Serve over rice.

ingredients: 2 tbsp flax meal + 5 tbsp water (or 2 regular eggs)
Coconut or olive oil for cooking
1 jalapeno, seeds removed and finely chopped
1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
1/2 cup oat flour or regular flour
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Prepare flax eggs if using. Cook quinoa, then sauté onion, bell pepper, jalapeno, garlic, and spinach until soft. Mash black beans, mix with quinoa, vegetables, spices, flax eggs, and flour. Form 10–12 patties. Bake 20 minutes, flip, then bake 25–30 more minutes until browned. Serve on buns, in lettuce wraps, or tortillas with toppings.

ingredients: Sauce: 1 cup chicken broth, 1/8 tsp pepper, 1/4 cup flour, 1 cup fat-free half-and-half or milk, 1 can chopped green chilies (4.5 oz)
directions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Sauté onion until tender; add chicken, salsa, cumin, and oregano, simmer until liquid evaporates. Spoon 1/2 cup mixture into each tortilla, top with 2 tbsp cheese, fold, and place seam-down on greased pan. Bake 15 minutes. For sauce, heat broth with pepper until dissolved, whisk in flour and half-and-half, boil 2 minutes, stir in chilies. Serve chimichangas with sauce.

Combine lime juice, dressing, garlic, basil, thyme, salt, and pepper. Pour 1 cup marinade into a resealable bag, add chicken, seal, and coat. Marinate at least 15 minutes. Drain and discard marinade. Cook chicken by grilling 40–45 minutes, baking at 350°F for 30–35 minutes, or pan-frying until juices run clear.

Cook pasta according to package, cool. Preheat oven to 350°F. Mix cheeses, parsley, salt, and pepper. Fill pasta tubes with cheese mixture. Spread thin layer of sauce in a 13x9 pan, arrange filled pasta, cover with remaining sauce. Cover with foil, bake 40 minutes. Remove foil, bake 15 minutes more until hot and bubbly.

Preheat oven to 350°F. Cook tortellini per package and drain. Cook bacon/pancetta, reserve 2 tbsp drippings. Sauté garlic in drippings, whisk in flour, slowly add milk, bring to simmer with seasonings and lemon. Mix tortellini, spinach, half cheeses, bacon, and sauce, place in baking dish. Top with remaining cheeses and reserved bacon. Cover with foil, bake 20 minutes, remove foil and bake 5–10 minutes more.

Heat oil in skillet, sauté onion 6–8 min until soft. Add garlic and jalapeño 2 min. Add zucchini and bell pepper 8–10 min until softened. Stir in corn, tomato, quinoa, black beans, spices, and cilantro if desired. Fill tortillas with mixture, add cheese if using, roll burritos, wrap for freezing or serve immediately.

ingredients: 4 cups cooked quinoa or brown rice
1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
Optional toppings: Greek yogurt, guacamole, crushed tortilla chips
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Mix all ingredients (except toppings) in a bowl. Transfer to greased 13x9-inch dish, sprinkle extra cheese, bake 20–25 min until heated through and cheese bubbles. Let cool slightly, add toppings as desired.

Prepare 9 lasagna noodles according to package directions. Preheat oven to 350°F. Brown ground beef in saucepan, drain. Add pasta sauce and water, simmer 10 minutes. Mix ricotta, half mozzarella, Parmesan, eggs, parsley, salt, and pepper. Spread 1 cup meat sauce in baking dish. Layer noodles, sauce, and cheese filling. Repeat layers, top with remaining sauce and mozzarella. Cover with foil, bake 45 minutes, remove foil, bake 10 more minutes, let stand 10 minutes before cutting.

Heat olive oil in pot over medium heat. Sauté onions and spices 10 min until fragrant. Add garlic 2 min. Stir in remaining ingredients except cilantro. Cover and simmer until potatoes and carrots are tender, about 1 hour. Serve over couscous or rice, garnish with cilantro. Optionally add cooked meat for protein.

ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breast tenderloins or strips
directions: Mix pineapple juice, brown sugar, and soy sauce in saucepan, heat until nearly boiling. Cover chicken with marinade, refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Preheat grill to medium. Thread chicken on skewers, grill 5 min per side until juices run clear. Alternatively, bake in oven at 375–400°F: 15 min, flip, 15 min more. Serve with rice and vegetables.

ingredients: 1 oven roast (2 lbs beef, pork loin, or turkey breast)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place roast on rack in shallow pan. Rub salt and pepper over meat. Roast 1–1.5 hours or until thermometer reads 150–155°F for beef/pork, 165°F for turkey. Remove from oven, let rest 10–15 minutes before slicing. Optional: add vegetables and cook in crockpot on low for 6 hours.

Preheat oven to 400°F. Combine yeast and warm water, let sit 5 minutes until bubbly. Mix in remaining ingredients, knead until smooth. Let dough rise 15–20 minutes. Roll onto pan or pizza stone, bake 6–8 min for thin crust, 8 min for standard. Add toppings, bake additional 10–12 min until heated and cheese melted.

ingredients: 10 oz raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
directions: Sauté sausage in olive oil to render fat, remove and set aside. Sauté garlic, onions, peppers, celery, green onions in sausage fat; add more oil if needed. Season with Cajun spices. Add rice, coat with fat. Stir in tomatoes and stock, bring to boil. Add shrimp and sausage, simmer 20 min until rice is tender and liquid absorbed. Adjust seasonings and serve.

ingredients: 7 1/2 cups sliced fruit (peaches, plums, apricots, berries, apples, pears, etc.)
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Lightly oil a 9x13 inch baking dish. Combine fruit, sugar, flour, and orange juice; pour into dish. In same bowl, mix oats, nuts, brown sugar, flour, cinnamon, and olive oil for topping. Sprinkle topping over fruit. Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbling and golden. Serve warm with cream or ice cream.

ingredients: 1/4 cup raisins or other dried fruit (optional)
directions: Whisk sugar, cornstarch, and eggs in medium saucepan. Add milk, rice, and raisins; cook over medium heat, stirring often until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla. Serve warm or cold.

ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped dried fruit (cranberries, raisins, dates, currants, etc.)
3/4 cup boiling water or apple juice
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Core apples, leaving 1/2 inch bottom intact. Mix sugar, cinnamon, dried fruit, pecans; stuff into apples. Dot each with butter. Place in baking dish, add boiling water/juice, cover with foil. Bake 30–40 min until tender, baste with pan juices. Serve warm with ice cream, whipped cream, or yogurt.

ingredients: Optional: chopped nuts, chocolate chips, coconut flakes, dried fruit
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Beat beans, oil, sugars, egg, and vanilla until smooth. Mix oats, flour, salt, and baking soda in separate bowl; combine with bean mixture. Add optional ingredients. Drop onto greased cookie sheets. Bake 8–10 min. Cool 5 min on sheet, then transfer to wire rack. Cool completely.
Peel oranges and slice into 1/4-inch wheels. Place in bowl, sprinkle lightly with cinnamon, stir to combine. Serve immediately.

ingredients: 1 cup pineapple chunks, fresh or canned
directions: Place yogurt and pineapple in a large plastic bag, flatten, and freeze at least 6 hours. Blend yogurt, pineapple, and orange juice until smooth. Serve immediately or freeze up to 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
